page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text, no marginal notes. Running head at top right. Catchword "aptum" at the lower right, signature "p 5" at the foot. Faint show-through text at the lower right and ink marks along the left edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: modum cum iisdem facta confociatio. Quibus vixdū ab Oreste pronunciatis, ne expectata quidem ejus peroratione, Achæi omnes ex hospitio legatorum in publicum se proripientes confestim populum, qui aderat, ad concionem vocarunt. Is sine morā, cognitā senatus Romani sententiā, in Spartanos, qui tunc forte Corinthi erant, quos ex habitu indicisque aliis agnoscebant, aut agnoscere se putabant, etiam in eos, qui in hospitium Orestis audito tumultu velut in asylum confugerant, vi inde extractos male multarunt, frustra se interponentibus legatis, & de injuriā contumeliisque, quibus priores ipsi Romanos laederent, conquerentibus. Quidam scriptores Romani adjiciunt, ut honorem populi sui tueantur, legatos ipsos etiam aut pulsatos, aut cōtumeliā affectos fuisse. Dein post dies non multos, secretis dimissisque iis, qui per ignorantiam pro Laconibus apprehensi fuerant, veros Lacones in carceres Achæi conjecerunt. Tum legati ab iisdem Achæis Romam missi: verum hi obviam facti legatis Romanis hujus rei causa in Achaiam euntibus cum iisdem pedem retulere. Simul Diæus expleto præturæ suæ tempore Critolaum cessorem [?] acceperat, virum temerarium,

page.notes: Page number "233" is read from the top right and may be slightly blurred. The word after "Critolaum" is printed "cessorem" and is transcribed as "cessorem" with [?]; it may be an abbreviated or misprinted form of "successorem". The signature "p 5" at the foot is hard to read and may be "p 5" or a similar gathering mark. The text has no visible paragraph indents on this scan, so it is set as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. Ink marks along the left edge and faint show-through at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
